incidents.notes: Venus-fork market over-borrow via redeemUnderlying/collateral accounting flaw

sources.ref: re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. The victim is a Compound Unitroller; comptrollerImplementation is storage slot 2 (named layout via `cast storage`). Exactly one NewImplementation(address,address) fires, at block 25390597 (2023-02-05T01:25:23Z), 246 s after the Unitroller's own creation at block 25390515 (1675560077) - it is the initial wiring of the same deployment session, preceded by the matching NewPendingImplementation pair. Slot 2 is constant at 0x55decf1b592b1b3ff8af3fe801b0780276d222bc from that block to the incident (25-point probe) and callTracer on the exploit tx shows the Unitroller delegatecalling only that address (zero DELEGATECALL opcodes of its own). The 246 s is 0.0008% of the 375-day age, so the measurement is left on the deployment basis.
